q1_issues.issue: The per-member distribution rule reuses the single constant sk_mire_essence_1 as each member's Patient, asserting that every lantern burns that same portion, where the object is an indefinite mass introduced under the distributed plural and so is a dependent existential (a Skolem term of $x per the dependent-existential rule).

q2_gaps: "extra" as an above-normal / additive quantity modifier on a mass noun: the Degree quantity-marker vocabulary is a closed three-symbol set (excessive / insufficient / sufficient) tied to too much / too little / enough, and no other carrier is defined for a comparative-quantity modifier with an elided standard
notes: Statement 11 coins a fourth quantity marker, (Degree sk_mire_essence_1 quantity extra), for the gap above. The Northgate-spokesman Possession for "Cliff Path stations", the group+Cardinality+group-event+per-member-rule shape for the counted plural, and the mire_essence genus (noun modifier not exposed) are all correct.
